claims.quote: The origin of lace is disputed by historians. An Italian claim is a will of 1493 by the Milanese Sforza family.
A Flemish claim is lace on the alb of a worshiping priest in a painting about 1485 by Hans Memling.
claims.note: Flemish claim, lace in a 1485 painting

claims.quote: Lace arrived in France when Catherine de Medici, newly married to King Henry II in 1533, brought Venetian lace-makers to her new homeland.
